# Deep Bhavsar

> Portfolio of Deep Bhavsar, an AI automation engineer focused on forward-deployed engineering, workflow automation, and applied AI.

## About

Deep Bhavsar builds practical software around real operational problems, from understanding a workflow through integration, launch, and handoff.

## Selected work

- Shayona Store: production catalog and document workflows built with self-hosted n8n, Google Drive, and Google Sheets for a real retail operation. Workflow exports and connected account identifiers are private.
- Desktop assistant: voice-enabled desktop actions and task automation.
- Chat application: streamed model responses, backend APIs, and persistent conversation history.
- Data science learning repository: hands-on projects in data cleaning, analysis, visualization, and predictive modeling.
